_comment: Tier-2: backends.kratos.generators.KNOWLEDGE is the ONLY per-physics catalog the Kratos backend consumes, and data/kratos_knowledge exports per-application constants rather than a unified KRATOS_KNOWLEDGE dict — so a get_knowledge that wrapped `from kratos_knowledge import KRATOS_KNOWLEDGE` in try/except would silently run its fallback branch forever. Pitfall (kratos._auxiliary_overview #6). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). Verified against the repository as it stands: the generators catalog is a populated dict, the backend imports it, and the backend source contains no reference to kratos_knowledge at all — the dead branch the claim describes was removed and this fixture goes red if it is reintroduced. Kratos itself is imported at module scope so the fixture cannot report on a machine without it. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. MUTATION CONTROL (T2_MUTATE=1, re-runnable): the dead `from data.kratos_knowledge import KRATOS_KNOWLEDGE` branch was already removed, so it cannot be removed again; the mutation REINSTATES it by appending that exact line to the backend source text the AST scan parses, putting the backend back into the state the claim describes. The scan is untouched and still ast.parses the real module. These expect_in_output strings disappear: backend_imports_data_kratos_knowledge=False, source_of_truth_mismatches=0 — the mutant prints them as True and 1, and also trips the forbidden token FAIL:. This is what proves the printed False is a measurement of the backend's import graph rather than a constant. SCOPE FIX in the same pass: `data/` sits at the repo ROOT, not under src/, so `import data.kratos_knowledge` always landed in its except branch for a sys.path reason and the half of the claim that is ABOUT what that module exports was never exercised at all; the repo root is now appended to sys.path and data_kratos_knowledge_importable=True plus exports_KRATOS_KNOWLEDGE=False are asserted, so that half is really measured now. Repo-root lookup hardened in the same pass: parents[4] does not exist inside the mutation harness's scratch tree, so the fixture now searches upward for src/backends/kratos/generators and falls back to $OASIS_REPO, aborting with FIXTURE_ABORT=no_oasis_checkout rather than reporting a pass if neither resolves; the proof therefore also sets OASIS_REPO=/home/alexander/Schreibtisch/ofa-consolidate. Proof environment: KRATOS_PYTHON=/mnt/kratos-tier2/kv/bin/python (28 applications; the repo-venv Kratos wheel does not load on this glibc and /usr/bin/python3 cannot import this repo). Proved KILLED 2026-08-07.

_mutation.note: The dead `from data.kratos_knowledge import KRATOS_KNOWLEDGE` branch the claim describes was already removed, so it cannot be removed again. The mutation REINSTATES it — it appends that exact import line to the backend source text the AST scan parses, putting the backend back into the state the claim describes. The scan itself is untouched and still ast.parses the real backend module.

_key_correction: The fixture's physics field says '_auxiliary_overview', with a leading underscore; the registry key that get_knowledge() answers to is 'auxiliary_overview' without one. The fallback key '_auxiliary_overview::6' therefore named no claim and this fixture credited nothing, while the claim it verifies sat uncovered. Adding an explicit covers list fixes the link without touching the physics field that the runner groups by. Index confirmed against the claim text.
